title: World Bloom — Break Down the Wall — Episode6 Her Voice

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD continue their intensive training, set on surpassing RAD WEEKEND. But one day in the Street SEKAI, a new area suddenly appears: an unfamiliar plaza, in which stands a huge wall...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
An, is something bothering you?
You've been staring up at that wall for a while now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh! Hi, Miku...!
Haha. You caught me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
How do I put it...?
Knowing that this is how we perceive RAD WEEKEND has me thinking about a lot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi and everyone really did put on a legendary event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I'll need to do what I have to to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you think you'll be able to?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All that's left for me to do is act when the time comes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still don't have an answer for the thing that's really got me hung up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND and see what it's like beyond that dream. We're gonna do the thing Aunt Nagi didn't get to. I don't have any doubt about that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I still don't know what to do about how I feel about Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
She's my partner...
She means more to me than anyone else...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because I wanna keep up with her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna get closure on this before we surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because we definitely won't be able to if I still have lingering doubts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll be keeping an eye on how you deal with this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I'll be looking forward to seeing some nice results.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! I hope you'll be ready then!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey... Did you hear that just now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...!
There's a crack in the wall!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A pretty big one too...
But why now all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But it doesn't sound like Kohane or any of the others. Who could it—)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It can't be...
But, it is...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(What's she doing here?!
I mean, she's...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But if she is, who was that...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(If so...
Was that Aunt Nagi like a ghost or something...?)
